definitions.explanation: A formal party held after a wedding ceremony to celebrate and officially announce the marriage to guests.

examples.japanese: {披露宴|ひろうえん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{百人|ひゃくにん}→百人：10985_hyakunin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{招待客|しょうたいきゃく}→招待客：28262_shoutaikyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|き}た→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: One hundred guests came to the wedding reception.

examples.japanese: {披露宴|ひろうえん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦スピーチ→スピーチ：03852_supiichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たの}まれた→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧。
examples.english: I was asked to give a speech at the wedding reception.

examples.japanese: {披露宴|ひろうえん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{三時間|さんじかん}→三時間：30478_sanjikan⟧⟦ほど→ほど：01724_hodo⟧⟦{続|つづ}いた→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: The wedding reception lasted about three hours.
